                [32m'  is a no-op.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `edit_order_form/1` must present nested children in ascending stored `position`, independently of\n'[39m +
                [32m'  the order the storage engine happens to return them in.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- Removing a nested form from an edit form and saving must destroy exactly that stored record,\n'[39m +
                [32m'  leaving unrelated records untouched.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `save/2` takes the form and either a parameter map (which must be validated into the form before\n'[39m +
                [32m'  submitting) or `nil` (submit what the form already holds). On success it returns\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `{:ok, order}` where `order` is the persisted `Catering.Orders.Order` struct with `customer`,\n'[39m +
                [32m"  `line_items` and each line item's `modifiers` already loaded, and with the line items and the\n"[39m +
                [32m'  modifiers in ascending `position`. On failure it returns `{:error, form}` where `form` is the\n'[39m +
                [32m'  re-usable `%AshPhoenix.Form{}` carrying the errors, and nothing has been written.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `hidden_inputs/2` returns a `%{String.t() => String.t()}` map: every hidden input key (including\n'[39m +
                [32m'  the form-type marker `_form_type`, the touched-field marker `_touched`, the primary key of an\n'[39m +
                [32m'  existing record, and the union member marker `_union_type`) mapped to its string value.\n'[39m +

                [32m'  without errors must be absent from the map.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `raw_error_list/2` returns the errors of the form at `path` as a list of\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `{field :: atom(), message :: String.t(), vars :: keyword()}` tuples with the message left\n'[39m +
                [32m'  untranslated (substitution variables not interpolated), sorted ascending by field name and then\n'[39m +
                [32m'  by message.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `serialize/1` returns, for the form it is given and recursively for every nested form, a map with\n'[39m +

                [32m'  - `"name"` — the form\'s HTML name.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"id"` — the form\'s HTML id.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"type"` — `"create"`, `"update"` or `"read"`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"resource"` — the form\'s resource module rendered with `inspect/1`, e.g.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    `"Catering.Orders.LineItem"`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"valid"` — the form\'s validity as a boolean.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"hidden"` — the same map as `hidden_inputs/2` would return for this form, but **without** the\n'[39m +
                [32m'    `_touched` entry.\n'[39m +

                [32m'    `to_string/1`, or `nil` when the value is `nil`. The fields are, per resource:\n'[39m +

                [32m'- `Catering.Orders.LineItem` — `dish` (string, required), `quantity` (integer, must be positive),\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `position` (integer); `belongs_to :order`, `has_many :modifiers`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `Catering.Orders.Modifier` — `label` (string, required), `surcharge_cents` (integer, must not be\n'[39m +
                [32m'  negative), `position` (integer); `belongs_to :line_item`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `Catering.Orders.Customer` — `name` and `email` (both strings, required).\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'The `:place` and `:revise` actions already manage the whole `Order -> LineItem -> Modifier`\n'[39m +
                [32m'graph, the embedded delivery windows, the fulfillment union and the customer (which may either be\n'[39m +
                [32m'created inline from its attributes or matched to an already stored customer) from a single set of\n'[39m +
                [32m"submitted parameters, and they derive each child's `position` from the order in which the children\n"[39m +
                [32m'are submitted.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'The LiveView layer that will consume this is not part of this task: everything must be reachable\n'[39m +
                [32m'through plain function calls, with no HTTP server and no browser.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'## Requirements\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Create `Catering.Forms`, a single facade module that a LiveView would use to build, mutate,\n'[39m +
                [32m'inspect and submit the whole nested order form. It must expose exactly these functions:\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'1. `new_order_form/0` — a blank create form for the order graph.\n'[39m +
                [32m'2. `edit_order_form/1` — takes an order id and returns an update form for the stored order,\n'[39m +
                [32m'   including nested forms for its existing line items and their modifiers.\n'[39m +
                [32m'3. `to_phoenix_form/1` — the `%Phoenix.HTML.Form{}` for a form.\n'[39m +
                [32m'4. `change/2` and `change/3` — revalidate a form against a fresh parameter map, with an optional\n'[39m +
                [32m'   keyword list of validation options.\n'[39m +
                [32m'5. `add_nested/2` and `add_nested/3` — add a nested form at a path, with an optional keyword list\n'[39m +
                [32m'   of options.\n'[39m +
                [32m'6. `remove_nested/2` — remove the nested form at a path.\n'[39m +
                [32m'7. `reorder/3` — reorder the nested list at a path, given the new ordering as a list of the\n'[39m +
                [32m'   current zero-based indices.\n'[39m +
                [32m'8. `move/3` — move the single nested form at a path one slot earlier (`:up`) or later (`:down`).\n'[39m +
                [32m'9. `submitted_params/1` — the parameter map that would be sent to the underlying action.\n'[39m +
                [32m'10. `hidden_inputs/2` — the hidden inputs required to render the form at a path.\n'[39m +
                [32m'11. `error_map/1` — the user-facing errors of the whole form tree.\n'[39m +
                [32m'12. `raw_error_list/2` — the untranslated errors of the form at a path.\n'[39m +
                [32m'13. `serialize/1` — a deterministic, plain-data snapshot of the whole form tree.\n'[39m +
                [32m'14. `save/2` — submit the form and persist the whole graph.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'## Implementation Hints\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'- Project path: `/home/user/catering`. Write the module to\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `/home/user/catering/lib/catering/forms.ex`. A stub of that file already exists; replace it.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  Do not add or remove dependencies, and do not modify anything under\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `/home/user/catering/lib/catering/orders/` or `/home/user/catering/lib/catering/orders.ex`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  The environment is offline; everything needed is already vendored and compiled.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- Every form-valued function returns an `%AshPhoenix.Form{}` struct (never a\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `%Phoenix.HTML.Form{}`), except `to_phoenix_form/1`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- The root form is named `order`: `form.name` and `form.id` are both `"order"`, so its nested\n'[39m +
                [32m'  forms are named `order[line_items][0]`, `order[line_items][0][modifiers][1]`,\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `order[delivery_windows][0]`, `order[customer]` and `order[fulfillment]`. A blank\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `new_order_form/0` must expose exactly the nested-form keys `:customer`, `:delivery_windows`,\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `:fulfillment` and `:line_items`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- Every `path` argument of `add_nested`, `remove_nested`, `reorder`, `move`, `hidden_inputs` and\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `raw_error_list` is one of those full HTML names as a `String.t()`, rooted at `"order"` — for\n'[39m +
                [32m'  example `"order[line_items]"`, `"order[line_items][0][modifiers]"` or\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `"order[line_items][0][modifiers][1]"`. `"order"` itself refers to the root form. Paths at any\n'[39m +
                [32m'  depth must work.\n'[39m +
                [32m"- `new_order_form/0` builds a create form for `Catering.Orders.Order`'s `:place` action;\n"[39m +
                [32m'  `edit_order_form/1` builds an update form for the `:revise` action of the order with that id.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- The third argument of `change/3` and `add_nested/3` is a keyword list that must be forwarded\n'[39m +
                [32m'  unchanged to the underlying ash_phoenix operation; callers rely on options that hide errors,\n'[39m +
                [32m'  restrict validation to touched fields, seed the new nested form with parameters, insert it at\n'[39m +
                [32m'  the front of the list, or give it a non-default action type. Both functions must also be\n'[39m +
                [32m'  callable at the lower arity with the options defaulting to `[]`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `reorder/3` and `move/3` change the visible order **and** the order that will be submitted: the\n'[39m +
                [32m'  reordered children must appear in the new order in `submitted_params/1`, they must be renamed to\n'[39m +
                [32m'  their new indices, and `save/2` must persist the new order. `move/3` at either boundary of a list\n'[39m +
                [32m'  is a no-op.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `edit_order_form/1` must present nested children in ascending stored `position`, independently of\n'[39m +
                [32m'  the order the storage engine happens to return them in.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- Removing a nested form from an edit form and saving must destroy exactly that stored record,\n'[39m +
                [32m'  leaving unrelated records untouched.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `save/2` takes the form and either a parameter map (which must be validated into the form before\n'[39m +
                [32m'  submitting) or `nil` (submit what the form already holds). On success it returns\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `{:ok, order}` where `order` is the persisted `Catering.Orders.Order` struct with `customer`,\n'[39m +
                [32m"  `line_items` and each line item's `modifiers` already loaded, and with the line items and the\n"[39m +
                [32m'  modifiers in ascending `position`. On failure it returns `{:error, form}` where `form` is the\n'[39m +
                [32m'  re-usable `%AshPhoenix.Form{}` carrying the errors, and nothing has been written.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `hidden_inputs/2` returns a `%{String.t() => String.t()}` map: every hidden input key (including\n'[39m +
                [32m'  the form-type marker `_form_type`, the touched-field marker `_touched`, the primary key of an\n'[39m +
                [32m'  existing record, and the union member marker `_union_type`) mapped to its string value.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `error_map/1` returns a `%{String.t() => [[String.t()]]}` map, keyed by the **HTML name of the\n'[39m +
                [32m'  form that owns the errors** (`"order"`, `"order[line_items][0]"`, …). Each value is the list of\n'[39m +
                [32m"  that form's own errors as two-element lists `[field_name, message]`, sorted ascending. Forms\n"[39m +
                [32m'  without errors must be absent from the map.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `raw_error_list/2` returns the errors of the form at `path` as a list of\n'[39m +
                [32m'  `{field :: atom(), message :: String.t(), vars :: keyword()}` tuples with the message left\n'[39m +
                [32m'  untranslated (substitution variables not interpolated), sorted ascending by field name and then\n'[39m +
                [32m'  by message.\n'[39m +
                [32m'- `serialize/1` returns, for the form it is given and recursively for every nested form, a map with\n'[39m +
                [32m'  exactly these string keys:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"name"` — the form\'s HTML name.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"id"` — the form\'s HTML id.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"type"` — `"create"`, `"update"` or `"read"`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"resource"` — the form\'s resource module rendered with `inspect/1`, e.g.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    `"Catering.Orders.LineItem"`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"valid"` — the form\'s validity as a boolean.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"hidden"` — the same map as `hidden_inputs/2` would return for this form, but **without** the\n'[39m +
                [32m'    `_touched` entry.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"values"` — a map from field name to the form\'s current value for that field, rendered with\n'[39m +
                [32m'    `to_string/1`, or `nil` when the value is `nil`. The fields are, per resource:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    `Order` → `reference`, `note`; `LineItem` → `dish`, `quantity`; `Modifier` → `label`,\n'[39m +
                [32m'    `surcharge_cents`; `Customer` → `name`, `email`; `DeliveryWindow` → `label`,\n'[39m +
                [32m'    `starts_at_minute`, `ends_at_minute`; `CourierDrop` → `street`, `postcode`;\n'[39m +
                [32m'    `CounterPickup` → `counter`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"errors"` — this form\'s own errors as two-element lists `[field_name, message]`, sorted\n'[39m +
                [32m'    ascending.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  - `"nested"` — a map whose keys are the string names of the nested-form keys that this form\n'[39m +
                [32m'    currently holds forms for, and whose values are the serialized child (for a single nested\n'[39m +
                [32m'    form), the list of serialized children in order (for a list of nested forms), or `nil`.'[39m
            }
          ]
        },
